title: Property Condition Disclosure Statement
description: NY RPL §462 requires sellers of 1-4 family residential property to complete a Property Condition Disclosure Statement OR give buyer a $500 credit at closing in lieu of the statement.

required_actions.note: Alternative: provide buyer a $500 credit at closing in lieu of the disclosure statement.

citations: N.Y. Real Prop. Law §462 et seq.

title: Agency Disclosure Form
description: NY agents must disclose their agency relationship at first substantial contact using the DOS-approved form.

title: Flood Zone Disclosure (Post-Sandy Amendment)
description: NY RPL §462 amended post-Sandy requires specific flood zone status disclosure including FEMA designation, flood insurance details, and known prior flood damage.

required_actions.note: Included in NY-PCDS Part V (Environmental). Include flood insurance history.

citations: N.Y. Real Prop. Law §462 (as amended 2022, eff. March 2023)

title: Condo/Co-op Offering Plan
description: For new condo sales and co-op transfers, the offering plan or proprietary lease and house rules must be provided to buyer.

title: NYC Real Property Transfer Tax
description: Properties in the five NYC boroughs: RPTT 1% under $500k; 1.425% at $500k+; mansion tax tiers above $1M.

required_actions.note: Filed by seller at closing with NYC Dept. of Finance.
